findings.text: EU G60 owners single out front-seat comfort on long drives as a strength.
Sport seats for driver and front passenger are standard on the 520i, 530e and i5 eDrive40.
G60 Europe volume is 61000 units in 2024 and 70000 units in the 2030 forecast.
The standard sport seats keep the list price of the entry variant competitive.
The driving dynamics are a core brand strength.
